title: Help
intro: Short answers for the grove — search, open a topic, or jump straight to a place in the app.
searchEmpty: Nothing matched. Try another word, or send feedback.
stillStuckBody: A short note or picture helps us fix what gets in the way.

workspace.title: Your workspace
workspace.body: The home grid is your grove menu. Tap a card to open that part of the app. Settings, feedback, and help sit under Account at the bottom.

record.title: The Log button
record.body: Use Log to leave a note, photo, work, money, or harvest entry. It saves on History for the field you chose.

chronologio.title: History
chronologio.body: Your grove story over time — weather, work, observations, and harvest days in one place. Open a month to read what happened.

fields.title: Fields & boundaries
fields.body: Each grove needs a name and a drawn boundary. The map unlocks area, weather, and satellite. Open a field for details, map, and History.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: See what is due, overdue, or coming up. Open a task to complete it, reschedule, or add a note. Proposals suggest work when the grove needs attention.

harvest.title: Harvest season
harvest.body: When harvest is live, log sacks by day and field, then mill and oil. The harvest flow keeps the season’s numbers in one place.

myOil.title: My oil
myOil.body: Track bulk oil and tins, commitments, and movements. Fill tins from stock and record gifts or sales without leaving the oil ledger.

money.title: Money
money.body: Log expenses and income for the grove. Filter by year or field. You can also record money from the + button.

partners.title: Partners & family
partners.body: Invite people who help on the field, set how much they can do, and find nearby services when you need extra hands.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Photos from the grove live in one hub. Add from the camera or library; they can also appear on History.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Language, theme, text size, notifications, and where the app opens. Changes save as you go.

feedback.title: Tell us what you saw
feedback.body: If something is unclear or broken, send a short note or picture. That is how The Olive Lot gets clearer in the grove.
